content.text: The vacation savings feature allows families to set a goal and follow a structured plan to save for their upcoming trips. The system will track progress and provide visual feedback on their savings journey.
The user shall be able to set a total savings goal for a vacation.
The system shall provide a predefined savings plan over a 12-month period.
The system shall display a chart showing the projected growth of savings.
The system shall track actual contributions against the plan.
Which savings plan aggressiveness (Relaxed, Balanced, or Strict) should be the default or selected for this feature?
